tagline: Surface Linear issue updates and sprint progress inside Microsoft Teams
metaTitle: Linear + Microsoft Teams Integration: Sprint Updates
metaDescription: Post sprint progress, issue assignments, and release announcements from Linear to Teams channels. GAIA keeps the whole company informed. See the setup steps.
intro:
Organizations that standardized on Microsoft Teams for communication often have engineering teams using Linear for issue tracking. Without integration, engineering updates stay in the tracker while the rest of the organization talks in chat — creating a visibility gap that forces stakeholders to request manual status updates constantly.

GAIA bridges the two so engineering progress is visible to the entire organization in the chat app they already use. Issue assignments, sprint updates, PR merges, and escalations appear in the relevant channels as formatted notifications. Non-engineers can ask GAIA in Teams for the status of any Linear project without needing an account.

For enterprise teams running on Microsoft 365, this integration fits naturally into an existing chat-centric workflow and eliminates the need for separate project status meetings.

useCases.title: Sprint progress channel updates
useCases.description: GAIA posts daily sprint burn-down updates to a designated Teams channel showing completed, in-progress, and blocked issues so stakeholders can track progress without interrupting engineers.

useCases.title: Issue assignment notifications
useCases.description: When a Linear issue is assigned, GAIA sends a message to the assigned engineer with full issue details, due date, and a direct link to the issue.

useCases.title: Cross-functional release announcements
useCases.description: When a cycle completes, GAIA posts a formatted release summary to the organization-wide channel listing all shipped features, with links to any associated documentation.

useCases.title: Escalation alerts to management channels
useCases.description: When an issue is escalated to Urgent or a cycle is at risk of missing its target date, GAIA posts an alert to the engineering manager's channel for immediate attention.

useCases.title: Linear queries from Teams
useCases.description: Team members can ask GAIA directly in chat, 'What's in the current sprint?' or 'Who owns the login bug?', and receive an accurate answer pulled live from the workspace.

howItWorks.step: Connect Linear and Microsoft Teams to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Linear workspace and install the GAIA app in your Microsoft Teams organization. Configure the channels where notifications should be posted.
Define which events generate notifications (sprint events, issue assignments, priority changes, PR links) and map each event type to the appropriate channel.

howItWorks.step: GAIA delivers updates and answers queries
howItWorks.description: GAIA posts real-time updates to the channels and responds to natural language queries about issue status, cycle progress, and team workload directly within conversations.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support channels within specific teams (team spaces)?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can post to any channel in any team space within your organization. You can map different issue-tracker teams to different channels with full granularity.

faqs.question: Can users create issues from chat without opening Linear?
faqs.answer: Yes. Users can describe a bug or feature request to GAIA in a chat or channel, and GAIA creates the issue and confirms the link in the conversation.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support Teams Adaptive Cards for richer notifications?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA uses Adaptive Cards to format notifications, including issue titles, descriptions, priority badges, assignees, and action buttons for common issue operations.

faqs.question: Is this compatible with mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes. The integration works on the mobile app as well as desktop and web. Notifications appear in real time across all clients.
